Frequently Asked Questions

Most frequent questions and answers about our adult Muay Thai program in Valley Ranch - Coppell.

Are These Adult Muay Thai Classes Beginner Friendly?

Yes! Almost all of our students had no experience at first. Yet with dedication and Muay Thai training, they've become amazing athletes and martial artists. We'll help you get there too.

What Do I Need To Bring To My First Lesson?

Just comfortable workout clothes, water, and an open mind. We provide gloves, wraps, and pads to use in class while you get started.

I'm Not Very Athletic, Will I Feel Left Out?

Not at all. Every class is coached to your own pace and fitness level, not the person next to you. Most of our adult students started out exactly where you are now.

Will Muay Thai Help With ADD/ADHD?

Many of our students find that the focus, structure, and physical intensity of Muay Thai training helps them settle their mind and burn off restless energy. It's not a medical treatment, but it's a great outlet.

What's Different About Different Martial Arts Styles?

Muay Thai focuses on striking with your fists, elbows, knees, and shins, while arts like Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu focus on grappling and ground control. Both build fitness, discipline, and self-defense skill in different ways.

I Have A Lot Of Pain, Limited Range Of Motion And Mobility - Is Muay Thai Right For Me?

Our coaches regularly adjust drills and intensity for students working around pain or limited mobility. Come try a class and we'll show you how training can be scaled to fit your body.

How Can I Get Started With Your Risk-Free Trial Offer?

Grab your free class pass above or give us a call. We'll get you scheduled for your first Valley Ranch – Coppell adult Muay Thai class, no obligation.
